kind: one-shot synthetic current-main construction; no live allocation
hypothesis: With the planner answer already completed, the current-main bounded drain consumes queued paired ammo evidence before reading the future result. Ammo 1 preserves the completed answer path; ammo 0 creates a policy invalidation that the actual final-admission boundary rejects even when the planner result itself is answer-eligible.
test: Execute frozen current-main drain_pending_observation_events with the actual paired health/ammo monitor and a completed/empty terminal, then pass the completed result and actual invalidation to the frozen planner adapter and final-action-admission helpers. Check source ordering from the exact main AST.
decision: PASS_CONSTRUCTION_RACE only if the exact main branch drains before future.result and final admission; the completed planner answer remains eligible in both cases; ammo 1 yields no invalidation and a fresh-action-validity status; ammo 0 yields ammo:below_hard_minimum and REJECTED_POLICY_INVALIDATED with no input authority.
counterhypothesis: The bounded drain may classify ammo zero but fail to preserve the invalidation through the completed-answer final-admission path, or may consume a terminal without confirming empty release.
limits: Synthetic typed values and deterministic planner/queue fakes do not establish real race frequency or HUD cadence.
No model, game, GUI, OS input, physical release, tactical ammo policy, recovery, progress, or task outcome is measured.
This validates the queued-completion seam and final-action gate only, not the full controller process.
retry_policy: Run candidate once after freeze. Preserve its first result and raw events; repeat only read-only audits and tests.
